sources.content:
# Atlas architecture
Atlas is a fictional collaborative work platform. The repository and published contract below form the reference source set.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Client[Web client] -->|HTTPS requests| API[Application API]
  API -->|queries and transactions| DB[PostgreSQL]
  API -->|enqueues jobs| Queue[Redis]
  Queue -->|delivers jobs| Worker[Background worker]
  Worker -->|stores attachments| Storage[Object storage]
  API -->|subscription events| Billing[Stripe]
  API -->|authenticates identity| Identity[OpenID Connect]
```

## Capabilities
- Workspace collaboration with scoped membership
- Project and task management with assignments
- Attachment uploads with signed download links
- Background exports with progress tracking
- Subscription billing via Stripe
- Audit history for administrative actions

## Implementation boundaries
The public contract declares Workspace, Project and Task resources. The deployment declares PostgreSQL, Redis and S3-compatible object storage. Runtime replication topology and tenant isolation are outside the supplied source set.

# Subscription plans
Public plan terms for the fictional Atlas product.

| Feature | Starter | Enterprise |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Workspace collaboration | Included | Included |
| Active projects | Up to 3 projects | Unlimited |
| Single sign-on | Not included | Included |
| Audit history | Not included | Included |
| Background exports | Up to 10 exports per month | Unlimited |
